cases.name: printed temporary remains before a waiting call and a mutation
cases.document:
kernel 1
numbers by_spelling
import 0 operation host.echo(value: Int) -> Int
definition "function kernel.anonymous() -> Any\nkernel 1\nmetering statements\nimport 0 operation host.echo(value: Int) -> Int\nbody {\n  do perform 0(1) as Int\n  set x = 2\n  return 3\n}\n"
main {
  let x = 1
  let saved = x
  let fnc = fn kernel.anonymous 
  let h = spawn apply fnc()
  let answer = join h
  finish (saved, x, answer)
}
